document_title: Both sides are printed on page 47241
alt_titles: Three Notices, And SEDS-AK Is Not One Of Them
The Objection And The Answer, Same Document
post_copy:
To the Administration for Native Americans. You stood up three notices for FY 2026. SEDS-AK is not one of them.

Your response to comments prints the objection. Commenters warned Alaska Tribes could face new barriers. The same pages answer that Alaska Native communities remain eligible across EAGLE.

No page anyone could reach shows what SEDS-AK was worth. The provable change is who names the work, and one of the three is an AI institute.

Enclosed, the objection and the reply as printed, EAGLE at $24,000,000, the AI3 Action Institute at $3,500,000, and the blank where SEDS-AK's number would go.

Both windows close 27 August. Until then a village office has to fit its own priority into a greenhouse, a microgrid, Welders to Elders or IDEAS, the one a community designs itself.

Is IDEAS wide enough to carry what SEDS-AK carried?

#AlaskaNative #ANCSA #AIinIndianCountry

aftercare: Post Tuesday to Thursday, 8 to 11am Alaska time. This deck carries a live deadline, so a good slot early in the week beats a polished one on Friday.
Paste the sources comment within 60 seconds of posting, before the first reshare, so the Federal Register and grants.gov links travel with the deck.
Before you post, re-check the days remaining against August 27. The caption and the close slide both turn on that date and it is wrong the moment the draft slips a day.

Stay in the comments for the first 90 minutes and reply to every one. Expect at least one person to say the program was cancelled. That word is contested, ANA says SEDS evolved, and the deck shows both on purpose.
If anyone asks what SEDS-AK was worth in dollars, say the figure is not obtainable and that the ACF grants page returns 403. Don't estimate a number the record can't carry.

Send the deck directly to two or three people who can act on it, a tribal consortium grants lead, a village corporation staffer, a regional nonprofit director. No Alaska newsroom has covered this and the window is 22 days.
At 48 hours, log saves and comments in the ledger and note whether the deadline framing or the argument slides drove the saves.
editor_notes_for_email: Four things to know before this goes out. The deck reached NO rung on the rendered ladder, because the treatment specified a GPU path that was never built, so what shipped is the Canvas path and the scorer graded it honestly rather than generously. What SEDS-AK was actually worth in dollars is not obtainable, the ACF grants page returns 403, and slide 08 says so out loud instead of guessing, so don't let anyone talk you into a figure in the comments. The Alaska Federation of Natives line is dated April 14, four months before this window and while the comment period was still open, and it belongs to the organisation, never to a named person, so keep it framed as AFN's position at the time. Slide 07 overprints EVOLVED and REPLACED so that neither word reads clean, which is deliberate, because the agency says one and the trade press says the other and the record does not settle it. If that slide looks like a rendering fault to a reader, it is working as designed, and the answer in the comments is that the document itself does not choose.
